reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08: the ISC dashboard reserve-balances API returns current USD-denominated holdings for Reserve A and Reserve B across cash, IB01 (iShares short-term Treasury ETF), SGLD (iShares physical gold ETC), VWRA (Vanguard global equity ETF), AGGU (iShares global aggregate bond ETF) and ISC. The two reserves are summed and converted to percentage slices against total reserve value. The single largest line is reserve-held ISC itself; it is treated as a self-reserve rather than external backing. The remaining slices track the whitepaper's five target asset families, but the API is undated, mutable, single-source and unaudited, and no independent reserve attestation has been selected. Custody providers and exact fund terms remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: ISC dashboard reserve-balances API as fetched 2026-08-08; combined Reserve A + Reserve B holdings
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer-published current allocation is undated, mutable, single-source and unaudited. Custody providers, legal entities behind Reserve A and Reserve B, account segregation, insolvency treatment and rehypothecation terms are not established.
